answer_1.quote: We evaluate different methods of lexically constrained machine translation on the Czech language.

answer_2.quote: BLEU scores are computed using SacreBLEU.

answer_4.quote: We manually analysed outputs marked as not having the desired constraint in the reference surface form by the automatic coverage evaluation introduced in the previous section.
answer_4.guideline: We analysed three models - baseline (B), a model trained with surface form constraints using canonical forms of the constraints at test time (SF), and a model trained with lemmatized constraints using lemmatized terminology entries at test time (L).
